name: Kumoi Azami
source:
Sex: Male
Occupation: Fisherman
Age: 19 years old

A young man born and raised on Kameshima, he has been friends with [url=/c163937]Yuza Minakuchi[/url] since childhood. He has a friendly and caring personality, and his willingness to help those around him has made him someone islanders of all ages rely on in times of need.
* * *
His [url=/c165566]father[/url] was a fisherman, and he accompanied him out to sea on his boat from a very young age. As a result, he grew up never doubting that he, too, would one day become a fisherman. After his father died in a maritime disaster five years ago, his mother —an ama diver— took on the responsibility of raising Azami and his much younger brother on her own.
During the closed season for diving, when his mother worked on the mainland, Azami was responsible for looking after his brother. After graduating middle school, he refused his mother's suggestion to attend high school and quickly obtained a 4th-class boat pilot license while helping with fishing around the island. He is now able to take his father's small fishing boat, the Saiun-Maru, out on fishing trips on his own.
* * *
He has a frank, easygoing relationship with Yuza, his childhood friend, and the two often get up to mischief together. Although he was happy for Yuza when he left to attend high school on the mainland and later found a job there, he also felt somewhat lonely. For this reason, he secretly welcomed the news that Yuza would be leaving his job and returning to Kameshima to take care of [url=/c164210]his grandmother[/url].

[From in-game profile]
